end.summary:
Discussed Diwali, Pongal, Baisakhi, and Makar Sankranti.
Practised linking harvest festivals with the season when crops are ready.
Kavya initially said festival dates were random and mixed up the seasons.
They later stated twice that festivals relate to crops being ready for harvest.
Teach-back was not passed; the harvest-season link was not fully secured.
end.parentNote: Asha practised how harvest festivals connect with the time when crops are ready, using examples such as Pongal and Baisakhi. Kavya shared familiar Diwali traditions and later repeated the correct harvest idea, but the earlier mix-up about random dates and winter timing was not fully corrected by the end. At home, ask Kavya to match one festival with its crop or harvest season and explain why it is celebrated.
